queries.query: Depalpur Pakistan official cadastral land records map Punjab land record authority
queries.result: Found the official Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA) public land-record service site and its linked GIS host. PLRA describes digitized land records and GIS-linked data across Punjab, but the public pages do not expose a Depalpur parcel download or anonymous parcel API.

Search results identified the same official Punjab Land Records Authority / Board of Revenue land-record services. No Depalpur-specific public cadastral viewer, parcel API, or local registry procedure with downloadable geometry was evidenced.

freshResearch.sourceAssessment: First-party provincial sources found; anonymous GIS probing was bounded to public service-directory and metadata requests only. No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe property fields were used.

registry.custodian: Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), under the Government of Punjab / Board of Revenue; Depalpur-local registry custodian not independently evidenced
registry.evidence: The official PLRA site documents province-wide land-record services and links the public GIS host. This is general provincial-agency evidence, not proof of a Depalpur-specific local registry endpoint.

parcelEvidence.note: No anonymous parcel feature response was obtained. The absence of an exact-point hit or usable geometry is a service-access and scope limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The WUP point was not shifted.
